description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PerformanceReviewAPITest' that tests the 'PerformanceReviewAPI' endpoints related to performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system. It includes test methods for getAll, delete, create, update, and getOne operations, utilizing mock services, fixtures, and data providers.
